name: Pink Enchanted Garden Butterfly Dress
description2: Made for birthday fun and celebrations. The airy net flare gives it a lively princess look while keeping it light and breezy to twirl in.

specs.fabric: Soft net with 3D floral decorations, golden butterfly motifs, and pearl embellishments
specs.fit: Comfortable round-neck body with ruffled sleeves and a full, net skirt

description: A bright rose-pink party frock designed with a fluffy, layered net skirt and charming flutter shoulder details. A lush diagonal cascade of colorful 3D flowers, golden butterflies, and shimmering crystal and pearl accents flows across the body down into the skirt.
